subject.title: chore: update glm-5.2 model cost pricing for input, output, and cache

question: Should this PR require redacted OpenClaw runtime/catalog proof before merge, or is official Z.AI pricing plus green CI enough for this small manifest pricing correction?
rationale: The diff appears correct, but ClawSweeper cannot waive the external-contributor real-behavior-proof gate or the compatibility impact of changing runtime cost accounting from unknown to known pricing.

options.title: Require runtime proof
options.body: Ask the contributor to add redacted OpenClaw catalog, models-list, or usage-cost output showing GLM-5.2 resolves to the patched pricing before merge.

options.title: Accept metadata-only proof
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally accept the official pricing page and CI as sufficient for this small metadata update while owning the missing runtime proof.

options.title: Pause for stronger vendor proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until Z.AI provides redacted billing/API evidence if maintainers want billing-side proof rather than public documentation.

recommendation.title: Require runtime proof
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to add redacted OpenClaw catalog, models-list, or usage-cost output showing GLM-5.2 resolves to the patched pricing before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed and closed the prior duplicate for provider-proof sufficiency and recently touched this plugin area.
